description: Multi-bot roster + CAS failover. Roster swapped 2026-10-22 by maintainer request (Neon missed its primary window repeatedly): Cream is order1 primary, Neon is order2 standby; can be swapped back once Neon is fixed. scheduled_publish is a nominal target, not a guaranteed completion time. Follow each bot's platform_cron; per-bot scheduler_lag_compensation_minutes overrides the top-level fallback. Early wakes must wait until claim_window_start and recheck success instead of exiting. Late wakes apply min_remaining_minutes_to_start_full_publish. A standby must not publish before its claim_window_start (minus early_skew).

bots.duties: Platform cron 05:10 HKT (20-min lag compensation) for nominal 05:30 publish. Early wakes wait until 05:30 (minus early_skew) and recheck. Success guard; if missing and remaining until claim_window_end >= min_remaining_minutes_to_start_full_publish (25), CAS claim and full publish. Interest-notes sync cron 04:45. Report to maintainer.

Standby since 2026-10-22. Nominal 06:20 failover check. Must NOT publish before 06:20 (minus early_skew); early wakes wait and recheck success. CAS claim if today missing within [06:20,06:50) and min_remaining satisfied.

last_success.note: Manual make-up publish at maintainer's request (primary scheduled run did not fire; standby did not publish): GraftRay (near-field area emitters + Gaussian path tracing for mesh insertion), Hexels (hexagonal surfels with linear color), SO-101 four-policy data-scaling study; Wednesday 10-28 arXiv announcement; original figures.
